description: This file defines a generic handler class for processing container file API endpoints in the LiteLLM project. It includes methods for synchronous and asynchronous HTTP requests, URL building, and endpoint configuration management, facilitating flexible interaction with container file endpoints defined in a JSON configuration.

classes.name: GenericContainerHandler
classes.description: A class providing a unified interface to handle various container file API endpoints, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous HTTP requests.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process a container file API request, delegating to sync or async handlers based on the _is_async flag.

methods.name: _sync_handle
methods.description: Performs a synchronous HTTP request to a specified container file endpoint, handling URL construction, request execution, and response parsing.

methods.name: _async_handle
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous HTTP request to a specified container file endpoint, handling URL construction, request execution, and response parsing.
